services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: The PADI Basic Open Water Classroom & Pool is the first step to becoming a PADI Open Water Diver. Class can be completed over one weekend. Once you have finished all the classroom and pool work, you can complete your four PADI Open Water Dives to complete your Open Water Diver Certification! Materials purchased separately. Medical form required. Step 2 Open Water Dives Local Option. From June to Sep, you can complete your open water certification closer to home at Aurora Reservoir. Although the water is cold and visibility limited, this is an option during the summer for completing your open water or continuing education dives without having to pay for travel or lodging. Summer water
